The trigger for the alert was the risk score. Tool calls: 8; closed cases consulted: CC-1313, CC-4816, CC-4637. An evidence request was simulated, and its assumed response is recorded in evidence_requests. Rationale: The action CLOSE_NO_FRAUD follows the closed‑case typology that clears alerts when the cardholder confirms a purchase from a new device (TYPO-0007). Because the customer did not deny the transaction, the trigger for the blocking and case‑creation requirements in the fraud policy (POL‑R2) is not met, so the case can be closed with no fraud.
